name: Pinch Lift
description: The first clip is pinched at one point like a handkerchief: its sides drop and swing in under the pinch, gathering into hanging pleats, then it is let go and falls down out of the frame, revealing the second clip behind its shadow. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Point where the cloth is pinched (0..1, y down)

params.name: pleats
params.description: Number of pleats hanging from the pinch

params.name: depth
params.description: Depth of the pleats and of their shading

params.name: swing
params.description: How far the hanging cloth swings before it settles

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the soft shadow cast on the second clip
